meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Compared the shared backend guidance with the existing two PHP agents and runtime/tool contracts. The new HTTP adapter formats public knowledge only and introduces no agent, provider call, private trace access or conversation store.

auth.review_note: Reviewed the exact public route session bypass against authentication and Google OAuth guides. Only /api/mcp skips session initialization; client cookies, tokens and capabilities do not select an actor, and normal login/API session handling remains intact.

commerce.review_note: Compared the public knowledge projection and new transport with catalogue/order/GST guides. Only published product data is reused; order ownership, payment writes, stock mutation and GST evidence stay behind existing authorized services.

content.review_note: Reviewed public ProductService and BlogService published selection and exclusion of future, draft, retired or private Markdown and paths.

foundation.review_note: Compared API/bootstrap and generated map changes with architecture, WebMCP, private JSON storage and deployment guides. Documented the stateless public endpoint separately from document-scoped tools and native agent answers, preserving MySQL business authority, private chat files and real-host acceptance limits.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed public layout script changes and frontend guidance against integration docs: global presentation and Support rendering do not alter Google tag configuration, script identity or reporting authorization.

http-errors.review_note: Compared the exact API MCP dispatch and bootstrap session guard with RequestFailureService and request-failures.md. The normal failure boundary still installs before environment work; the public transport catches its own failures as bounded 503 JSON without exception detail or session cookies.

interface.review_note: Reviewed renderer, Support and Enterprise templates, CSS, Design.md and UI skills: native scope requires matching answer first, public-only legacy responses fall back completely, reference cards are relevant/bounded, links stay approved and mobile/keyboard checks use production presenter fixtures.

mail.review_note: Reviewed the shared backend guidance and transactional mail contract. The public MCP tools expose published contact facts without contact submission, mail enqueueing or recipient changes; mail behavior is unchanged.

mcp-clients.review_note: Compared the trusted local STDIO interface and grant service with the shop and integrations guides. Clarified that its process has no HTTP listener; the separate public endpoint never consumes owner grants.

media.review_note: Compared the architecture change with media ownership/deletion guidance. The widget consumes the same validated public raster paths and introduces no upload, deletion, metadata mutation or additional media authority.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed the ProjectMap dependency and AdminHelp reference manifest. The added public MCP routes are static map metadata only; operator guide role checks and content loading remain unchanged.

public-mcp.review_note: Reviewed the dispatcher, controller, exact bootstrap route, public knowledge/A2UI projection, iframe bridge and official SDK/HTTP/AppBridge fixtures. Documented both explicit protocol profiles, four public tools, exact-page cards, origin/session boundaries, teardown/link recovery, native gates and the distinction between a tested host fixture and an installed chat connector.

sales-channels.review_note: Checked public product visibility, published navigation destinations and isolated first-party catalogue and policy discovery.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed CI, deployment workflow, documentation ownership and project-map source changes against the development workflow. Added required native default/modern client, HTTP and AppBridge gates plus read-only live MCP acceptance after the deployed-SHA gate; regenerated maps without changing review or deployment approval rules.
